answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 43 keys loses far more than 43 single identities would. The nectar graph is rebuilt each epoch, as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the atlas audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the prism checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
